prose: FEC data shows AI-oriented PACs spent nearly $80M on the 2026 US elections, mostly before the primaries - and, to almost everyone's surprise, pro-regulatory PACs have outspent the pro-industry network around Leading the Future in the midterms, as the AI accelerationists seemingly took their foot off the pedal, Puck reports. The article is blocked to the fetcher (HTTP 403), so figures come from the feed's account of the piece.
highlights: AI-oriented PACs spent nearly $80M on the 2026 US elections, mostly pre-primaries
Pro-regulatory PACs outspent the pro-industry Leading the Future network in the midterms
Puck reads it as the accelerationists stepping back
